_comment: Template .mcp.json for the llm-wiki MCP server. Copy into any project root and edit env vars as needed. Only LLM_WIKI_ROOT is required; remove other env entries (or leave them empty) to fall back to defaults.

_env_reference.LLM_WIKI_ROOT: REQUIRED. Absolute path to the local llm-wiki clone. The MCP imports agents/query/query_engine.py from here and resolves projects/<key>/ relative to it.
_env_reference.LLM_WIKI_PROJECT: Optional. Default project_key used when the caller omits it. Useful when copying this file into a single-project repo so the agent doesn't need to pass project_key on every call.
_env_reference.MODEL: Optional. Backend selector for the query engine's downstream LLM: 'codex' | 'codex/<id>' | 'claude' | 'claude/<id>' | '<id>'. Default: 'codex'. Note: query ops pin weak models internally (gpt-5.4-mini / claude-haiku-4-5); MODEL here only picks the CLI backend, not the model id.
_env_reference.UPDATE_PROJECTS_ROOT: Optional. Override for the projects/ root if your project state lives outside $LLM_WIKI_ROOT/projects. Rarely needed.
_env_reference.CODEX_BIN: Optional. Path to the codex CLI binary. Default: 'codex' (looked up on PATH).
_env_reference.CLAUDE_BIN: Optional. Path to the claude CLI binary. Default: 'claude' (looked up on PATH).
_env_reference.LLM_STUB_RESPONSES_DIR: Test-only. Path to a directory of stub response JSON files; short-circuits live LLM calls. Leave unset for normal use.
